column1: # Low-Latency Limit Order Book — sample replay data
# Price unit: dollars with 2 decimal places (e.g. 100.50 → stored as 10050 ticks)
# Order 7 buys at 100.50 → matches order 4 exactly (200 @ 100.50)
# ── Partial fill – resting order depleted across multiple aggressors ──────────
# Order 9 sells another 100 → consumes remaining 50 of order 1 + 50 of order 2
# No resting asks remain at 100.50; best ask is now 101.00 (order 5)
# Market buy 400 → consumes 300 of order 5 + 100 of order 6
# This triggers an immediate match against any resting bids ≥ 100.00
# MSFT market sell 200 → consumes remainder of order 101 (ask side)
# Zero-crossing: BUY and SELL at different non-crossing prices (no match)
# Cancel a non-existent order (engine silently ignores)
# Large sweep: single BUY sweeps multiple ask levels
